scope: Original local C2 issuer/client stores and targeted C3 recovery qualification. In-process APIs, public test issuer keys, raw bounded test assets, plaintext private SQLite files. No live service or deployed app integration.

baselineReview.result: Fresh CodeRabbit review and all CI/preview passed before merge. Bot review is not independent cryptographic validation.

runtime.sqlite: node:sqlite DatabaseSync, experimental flag, rollback journal, synchronous FULL
runtime.crypto: @noble/curves 2.4.0; frozen reference primitives, original ZFT-specific transcripts

verification.coverage: Lifecycle, exact backup/recovery, purpose/session/realm/asset/destination/wallet-context binding, malformed input, expiry and suspension, duplicate assets, identical retries, multiprocess races and SIGKILL.

verification.expected: Each temporary mutant exits 1 with its named assertion failure; no working source is mutated.

verification.result: Issue, export, claim with dropped response, restore into third store, stale-copy rejection, cancellation and unspent showing pass; walletAuthenticated is false.
Python 3.12 hash-pinned environment reproduces exact unchanged fixture bytes; subgroup and pairing checks pass.
13 dependency versions, pinned artifacts and retained license notices pass.
All 25 app test files passed with local simulated runtimes; no live ZVM endpoint used.

environmentNote: Initial sandboxed app tests could not create worktree/Wrangler temporary files; the original controls cleanup masked a denied file creation as ENOENT. Rerunning with approved local filesystem access passed without source changes.

realmRewrap.before: New regression fails on earlier unscoped local implementation: Missing expected exception.
realmRewrap.after: Same-key cross-realm relabeling rejects; editing h to the new realm rejects its signature.
realmRewrap.sustainedControl: Fourth temporary mutation removes the asset scope hash and still triggers the named test.

processFaults: SIGKILL after spend write before operation insertion/commit: neither row remains; exact pending request can complete.
SIGKILL after issuer commit before reply: exact durable response recovered.
SIGKILL after unblinding/verification before client save: saved journal completes after restart.
concurrency: Independent processes competing for one source nullifier: exactly one replacement.
Independent processes reserving one initial asset: exactly one issuance.
Independent identical submissions: byte-identical result and one operation.

documentationChecks.result: Passed relative file existence and Markdown heading-anchor checks; network links were not bulk checked.

unchanged: App, SDK, Worker and contract source
Brand assets, original untracked zft-logo and historical OG snapshots
Existing branches and worktree node_modules symlink

limitations: Both the frozen lab and new local profile share an author; no independent cryptographic review or external oracle for the new profile.
The new scoped asset attribute and transcripts are not reference-wire compatible; source license/server enforcement and live interoperability remain unverified.
Public test issuer keys, plaintext bearer/session persistence and unqualified BigInt secret operations are unsuitable for valuable assets.
Wallet address bytes are showing context, not a wallet endorsement; no authenticated status or public publication.
Selected SIGKILL and concurrent-writer tests do not qualify every transaction boundary, storage fault, power loss, corrupt/rolled-back backup or hosted execution.
Third local store recovery is not phone/browser cross-device acceptance; exact snapshot acknowledgment is an API gate, not proof of safe external backup.
Admission/retention, key rotation, trusted manifest distribution, entropy/backend review, browser/file/vault adapters and independent C1/C4 review remain open.
C2 local harness is complete; C3 is partial and C5/C6 integration/hosting are unimplemented.
ZVM is unavailable for upgrades per the user; live chain acceptance remains deferred.
